extracted.name: Almond Paste Bread Roll (Gluten Free!!!)
extracted.description: Almond Paste is the actual king when it comes to making breads! Not enough people know about this amazing recipe and I made this one gluten-free for my mom but you can use any flour you like!!!🤤
ingredient_lines: 2 1/2 cups flour of choice if you use all purpose or whole wheat you may only need 2 cups, base off of stickiness
instruction_lines: Mix the butter, flour, egg, sugar, almond extract, and spices. Add the yeast and water. Mix before covering with a towel and let sit for 2 hours
Preheat oven to 350 F or 180 C
Grate the almond paste and add the spices and brown sugar.
Spray parchment paper with canola oil and place dough on the paper. Spray another piece of parchment paper with canola oil and lay on top
Use a roller to roll the dough flat. Mix the filling with milk and place at one end of the dough, try to spend the almond paste filling as much as you can
Roll into a roll and cut small marks in the top of the bread. Fold in the bread ends to sort of close it. Chop the nuts and mix them with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Coat the bread and place in oven for 30-45 minutes checking often so the bottom doesn't burn.
Remove and cut into slices! I hope you enjoy and explore many almond paste recipes in the future!
